    lines=[r for r in range(H) if all(x!=fill for x in grid[r])]
    line=grid[lines[0]][0]
    wires=sorted({c for r in lines for c in range(W) if grid[r][c]!=line})
    out=[]

        r1,r2=lines[i],lines[i+1]
        row=[]
